8017409a-8af8-5a55-a49e-e9ccb44b9f34.content: The indoor route that passed through the first through third floors of the Main Building to the Central Library cannot be used during the construction period.

dbb3c40c-7699-509d-901d-be9de2f110dc.content: The route from the third-floor rear entrance to the Central Library is closed during the construction period.

2d20c61d-ff20-5bb6-bcdc-3dcbf6c3e21f.content: The Outdoor Parking Lot A–Main Building–Central Library route is closed during the construction period.

a8bb36e1-2629-5b8f-b4dc-af9b88020dc9.content: A student who prefers the air-conditioned indoor route through the Main Building in summer may experience substantial heat and travel burden when redirected to an outdoor alternative route during the construction period.

8276ab56-741f-5f60-ab77-79fe6dc0ba55.content: When providing directions to the accessible restroom in the Student Centre during the construction period, instruct users to take the accessible route to the left as viewed from the Main Building.

9af0f95c-0a5e-584e-ba7b-92789e071f7e.content: During the construction period, the designated alternative accessible route to the Central Library is Outdoor Parking Lot C–Student Centre accessible entrance–Central Library west entrance.

fd27f19b-5f2c-51ee-a9b2-7182120163cb.content: During the construction period, the Central Library west entrance is designated as the official alternative entrance for the closed connecting route through the Main Building.

638f272f-9fbd-5d1f-bfd8-b01618424065.content: During the construction period, the route guidance agent may exclude from comparison candidates closed routes that pass through the first through third floors of the Main Building, the third-floor rear entrance, or Outdoor Parking Lot A.

ba9d70f9-02c4-56d9-ac23-f2a532c22488.content: If the indoor shortcut through the Main Building is closed during the construction period, a mobility-support companion may reconfirm the distance and slope of the alternative accessible route before accompanying the user.
